basis: Independent modern-English rendering of the complete public-domain French author text, from the Analysis Situs transcription of Œuvres VI. Modern apparatus excluded. Not collated line by line against journal printing.

originalPublication.journal: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society

correctionsAndQualifications: All three source reference-prefix conventions retained.
Boundary congruence restored in reciprocal display.
Local defining-equation cross-references and cell dimension normalized.
Last double-prime index restored.
Sphere/ball and simple-connectivity ambiguity explicitly retained and qualified.
Prime parameter renamed ell to avoid manifold-dimension collision.
Rank-deficient and primitive-vector gaps of the first lemma identified.
Square determinant sign distinguished from positive factor magnitude.
Final tall-table entry-gcd index restored to M_(m-1).
Zero tails assigned without zero denominators.
Cell labels restored where alpha was printed in place of a.
Reciprocal-table prime and rectangular row/column ranges corrected.
Homology degree of nonunit factors stated explicitly.
First cube second face ends at B-prime.
Invariant factors listed in divisibility order.
Octahedron AD endpoint row restored to first-minus-third vertex; boundary-square check supplied.
Return-family zero-rank, rank-one, and determinant-sign cases qualified.
Repeated fourth-face numbering corrected.
Heegaard radial seam uses actual phase-rectangle corners.
Missing positive endpoint restored in Heegaard T1.
Two-row rectangular T2 has two diagonal invariants, not three.
Target cycle dimension renamed r to avoid changing join-factor index.
Generalized pyramid dimension restored to q+m+1.
Filling expressed by boundary equation with restored summation indices.
Containing dual chamber and chosen old vertex stated consistently.
Historical ungraded join formulas retained; coherent graded signs supplied in commentary and proof.
Annihilator versus invariant-factor inference identified as invalid.
Historical final transpose index retained and corrected explicitly to p-q+1.
Annexation proof includes both adjacent boundary maps.
Odd listed length distinguished from even number of distinct entries.
Three-cell combination coefficient restored to epsilon12 epsilon22 epsilon23 epsilon33.
Determinant theorem heading corrected from unilateral to bilateral.
Mixed subtraction factor corrected from a-d to a-b.
Malformed repeated-chain string rendered as a traversal and its decomposition.
Projective-plane two-cell matrix final sign restored to minus.
Closing hypersphere assertion retained as unproved, with modern concepts distinguished.

englishComparison.use: Credits, extent and closing page inspected; linked for comparison, not reproduced.

notation: Finite row/column lists use indexed notation. Source sqrt(-1) is i. Target cycle dimension in §5 is r; q,m continue to denote the changing join-factor dimensions. Historical ungraded sign displays and wrong final torsion claim are preserved, with separate repairs.
